headline: Utilities Are Up 8% on AI Power Demand. The Fund Actually Building the Data Centers Is Up 40%
summary: Utility stocks are riding the AI power wave, but the companies actually bolting together the data centers are running a very different race. Knowing which fund owns which part of the chain could change how you size your next trade.
